g.text: Session Creation - Validate and Persist, Assemble on First Execution
Agent.mode initializes Session.mode; missing legacy mode is build.
Failure before commit exposes no Session ID.
No MessageEntry, AgentSession or model inference is created.
The first execution assembles Agent, SYSTEM, Skills and tools.
No If-Match or Idempotency-Key. Each successful POST creates a Session.
Repeating an uncertain request may create another Session.
Background cleanup handles unbound orphan Sessions.
Target IDs use agent- or session- plus 32 hexadecimal UUID characters.
Database agent_id must support 38 characters; migrate VARCHAR(30) to 64.
No execution credentials are consumed; upstream performs authentication.
